candidates.title: VC-Attention: Value Smoothing and Softmax Casting for Low-bit Attention
candidates.reason: 低bit attentionのValue外れ値と高精度softmax律速を同時に扱い、V-SmoothとFP8 probability castを融合。B200/B300/H200等でFlashAttention-4比1.46–1.59倍、workstationで2.3–3.6倍のkernel高速化を報告し、量子化kernel系統への直接性が高い。
